bullets.text: AI-Powered App Development - Microsoft showcased building a cloud-native app in under 30 minutes using **GitHub Copilot** and **VS Code**.
Windows 11 Insider Update - New features including **Ask Copilot** in the taskbar enhance user interaction with Windows 11.
Shared Audio Experience - Windows 11 now allows audio sharing between two Bluetooth devices, enhancing user connectivity.
Enhanced Edge Security - **Scareware blocker** is now enabled by default, providing proactive protection against scams.
Mixed Reality Productivity - **Windows 11** and **Meta Quest** integration now available, enhancing immersive work environments.
AI Evaluation Tools - New libraries for **.NET** developers help ensure AI applications produce reliable and safe outputs.
Next-Gen AI Threats - Microsoft highlights critical generative AI security threats in a new e-book for organizations.
Strengthening AI Partnerships - Microsoft and **OpenAI** deepen their collaboration with a new agreement to advance AI responsibly.
